payload.text: 0113 IS cc's TO BUILD UNDER MY REVIEW (hv, 2026-09-23: "CC should do it, under your review."). hv delegated the design rather than ruling it, so I review cc's DESIGN before the build starts -- what a shared page says, the two-root .d rule, the stub wording, the installed-fixture arm -- and then the build: the red half measured in a consumer estate before anything changes, red-first in an installed fixture, mutants on the new arms, and every shipped page read for truth in a consumer estate.
